name: M&A Integration Thesis
axiom: Two trajectories meeting is a plan only where the cultures already overlap.
trigger: Mergers, acquisitions and internal reorganisations, where the synergy case must survive contact with two cultures.

steps.text: Trajectories: what each side does well alone.
Intersection: the specific work neither can do without the other.
Friction: where the two operating models disagree.
Unified platform: the single way of working, and who owns it.

antiPattern.violation: A synergy spreadsheet with no operating model, so the number is plausible and the first quarter of joint work is spent negotiating process.
antiPattern.remediation: Name the friction before the value. The integration plan is the answer to the culture question.

parametricParams.caption: TWO PATHS, ONE AFTER THE CROSSING
